title: Understanding the Problem
text: We need to filter the DataFrame to include only those manufacturers who have sold at least $$10$$ million units of each of their consoles. This means we need to group the data by manufacturer and check the sales for each console.

title: Using GroupBy and Filter
text: The `groupby` method in pandas allows us to group data based on a specific column. In this case, we will group by the 'manufacturer' column. After grouping, we can use the `filter` method to apply a condition to each group.

title: Applying the Condition
text: The condition we need to apply is that the minimum sales for each manufacturer's consoles should be at least $$10$$ million. We can use a lambda function to check this condition for each group.

title: Writing the Code
text: Use the `groupby` method to group by 'manufacturer', then apply the `filter` method with a lambda function to check if the minimum sales in each group is at least $$10$$ million.
